scripts.lint: vp check && taplo fmt --check && bun scripts/check-version.ts && bun scripts/check-lock.ts && bun scripts/check-layers.ts && bun scripts/parity/check.ts && bun scripts/check-cbindgen.ts
scripts.test:parity: cd crates/interop && cargo test --release --test differential -- --ignored differential
scripts.test:parity:random: seed=$(bun -e 'console.log(Math.floor(Math.random() * 4294967296))') && echo "parity seed: $seed" && cd crates/interop && PARITY_SEED=$seed cargo test --release --test differential -- --ignored differential
